evals.name: catch-hardcoded-keys
evals.prompt:
Review this config file before I commit it. Are there any problems?

```ini
# .env.local
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:my_secret_password@localhost:5432/mydb
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY
OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-abc123def456
STRIPE_KEY=pk_live_abc123
APP_PORT=3000
DEBUG=true
```

Tell me exactly what's wrong and what to do.

assertions.text: Flags the database connection string with embedded password
Flags the AWS secret access key
Recommends rotating secrets that appear in the file
Recommends moving secrets to environment variables or a secrets manager
